items.summary: CFO recommendation: maintain containment-only execution and authorize no spend, billing changes, monetization expansion, or new queue work. The only supported revenue evidence is Amazon data for 2026-09-21: 6,219 clicks, 28 ordered items, 6 shipped items, and $4.92 aggregate commission. The $4.92 cannot be assigned to a site. September 1–29 AI usage is $947.40 across 5,289 calls, but it is not period-matched to revenue, so margin, ROI, payback, and forecasts must not be inferred.

Contribution margin is unknown: matching-period site-attributed revenue and allocated costs are unavailable. The minimum measurement is a dated ledger matching each revenue item and cost item to the same site or content and period, including AI, infrastructure, domains, hosting, and other operating costs. Do not subtract the $947.40 AI total from $4.92 revenue because the periods and attribution scopes do not match.

Cost-to-learn is not calculable because no approved learning threshold, experiment denominator, or attributable outcome value is recorded. The minimum measurement is an approved per-test learning budget or threshold, test scope and dates, incremental AI/infrastructure cost, exposure count, and a measurable outcome tied to the tested site or content. Existing clicks, impressions, sessions, and proposals are not financial returns.

Budget exposure is unknown because monthly spend, fixed costs, marketing budget, revenue floor, and attribution materiality threshold are blank in the owner strategy. The minimum measurement is a dated approved budget register plus committed and incurred spend by cost category. Until then, retain containment and authorize no discretionary spend.

Continue existing period-aligned reconciliation only. Preserve aggregate provider earnings as unattributed; do not use named tracking-row clicks with zero site commission as revenue, and do not extrapolate the single 2026-09-21 revenue day into a monthly forecast. Continue deployed-work measurement and existing repair-or-close and readiness work without adding telemetry or duplicate requests.

Retain the existing saveusfarms.com repair-or-close case and complete or close it by 2026-09-30T07:30Z with dated ownership, root-cause or closure rationale, validation, rollback, release/security boundary, attribution limits, measurement limits, and deduplication evidence. This is containment work, not a basis for a financial claim.

Continue the existing parked-site readiness packets by 2026-09-30T17:00Z. Keep the scaffold properties parked, private, preview-only, and unlaunched; do not publish, deploy, configure analytics, monetize, spend, add dependencies, or create queue work.
